title: Run
description: One export of a compare set: the markup drawings, the change list and this record, all written under `<프로젝트>/출력/<run_date>[-n]/` (docs/contracts/r1.md §2, §3 `run`). Written verbatim as `run.json` next to the outputs and returned by `GET /compare/runs/{run_id}`, so screen D can show what was produced without re-reading the folder. Exporting twice on the same date does not overwrite: the second run gets `출력/<run_date>-2/` and layer `REV-<YYYYMMDD>-2`.

schema_version.description: Present in `run.json` on disk; the API response omits it.

run_date.description: The date the user entered on screen A, carried through unchanged. Fills the 일자 column of the revision table and the layer name.

output_dir.description: Absolute path of `<프로젝트>/출력/<run_date>[-n]/`. One of the two roots the write guard allows (docs/contracts/r1.md §2).

pair_ids.description: Sheet pairs that produced a file, in output order. A pair with no approved cluster is not exported and is not listed here.

approved_count.description: Clusters exported as cloud marks and revision-table rows across every pair.

ignored_count.description: Clusters the user marked 무시. Counted for the report; nothing is drawn for them.

files.description: The markup drawings that were written, in output order.

error_message.description: Why the run failed, in Korean, ready to show. Null unless `status` is `failed`.

created_at.description: When the `run` row was inserted. A database timestamp, not part of the deterministic output (docs/contracts/r1.md §11).

layer_name.title: RevisionLayerName
layer_name.description: `REV-<YYYYMMDD>`, with a `-<n>` suffix from the second export of the same date onwards. The compare DXF never carries the suffix -- it is added only by the export (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §2).

run_scope.title: RunScope
run_scope.description: R1 exports every pair that has an approved cluster. Exporting a chosen subset of sheets is a week-2 feature (CLAUDE.md rule 10), so the only value is `all`.

run_method.title: RunMethod
run_method.description: How the markup drawing is written, from `compare.yaml` `output.dwg_writer`. `auto` picks ZWCAD when it is available and falls back to `acad-ts`, then to `dxf-only`.

run_status.title: RunStatus
run_status.description: `running` while the export job is working, then `done` or `failed` (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

writer.title: OutputWriter
writer.description: Which writer actually produced this file. `dxf-only` means no DWG writer was available and a `.dxf` was written instead.

output_file.title: RunOutputFile
output_file.description: One markup drawing written by the run.

sheet_no.description: Drawing number used in the file name. Null when the sheet has none, in which case the source file name was used instead.

path.description: Absolute path of the written file, inside `output_dir`.

format.description: `dwg` when a DWG writer succeeded, `dxf` when the run had to fall back.
